script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(k.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', k.job_status, 'correlation_id', k.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', k.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', k.progress_message, 'error_code', k.error_code, 'error_message', k.error_message) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND k.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.key}}' AND k.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS gr_id, g.gr_no, g.gr_status, g.organization_id, CAST(g.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_receiving_eg6l4ywi_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.goods_receiving_id = {{node:code_node_RSguard.data.grId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0) AS line_count,
       (SELECT p.step_name FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'GRC|{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.grId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', o.job_status, 'correlation_id', o.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', o.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', o.progress_message, 'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message)) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.command = 'COMPLETE_GR' AND o.correlation_id = 'GR|{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.grId}}' AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED',
		'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_GR', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', x.job_status, 'correlation_id', x.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', x.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', x.progress_message, 'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command = 'COMPLETE_GR' AND x.correlation_id = 'GR|{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.grId}}' ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN goods_receiving g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_RSguard.data.grId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.`id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', i.`organization_id`, 'material_code', i.`material_code`, 'material_name', i.`material_name`,
		'material_desc', i.`material_desc`, 'based_uom', CAST(i.`based_uom` AS CHAR), 'material_costing_method', i.`material_costing_method`, 'purchase_unit_price', i.`purchase_unit_price`,
		'stock_control', i.`stock_control`, 'show_delivery', i.`show_delivery`, 'show_receiving', i.`show_receiving`, 'receiving_inspection', i.`receiving_inspection`,
		'item_batch_management', i.`item_batch_management`, 'serial_number_management', i.`serial_number_management`, 'batch_number_genaration', i.`batch_number_genaration`,
		'item_category', i.`item_category`, 'item_group_id', i.`item_group_id`, 'is_active', i.`is_active`, 'over_receive_tolerance', i.`over_receive_tolerance`), JSON_OBJECT('table_uom_conversion',
		COALESCE(
         (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(u.`id` AS CHAR), 'alt_uom_id', CAST(u.`alt_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'alt_qty', u.`alt_qty`, 'base_qty', u.`base_qty`,
		'base_uom_id', CAST(u.`base_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'over_receive_tolerance', u.`over_receive_tolerance`, 'over_delivery_tolerance', u.`over_delivery_tolerance`)) OVER (ORDER BY u.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
            FROM item_mji552rc_sub u WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), JSON_ARRAY()))) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.id IN ({{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.itemIdsSql}})
 ORDER BY i.id

script.code:
SELECT x.k, x.j FROM (
SELECT 'PS' AS k, s.id AS sid, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.`id` AS CHAR), 'plant_id', CAST(s.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', s.`organization_id`, 'movement_type',
		s.`movement_type`, 'putaway_required', s.`putaway_required`, 'auto_trigger_to', s.`auto_trigger_to`, 'auto_completed_gr', s.`auto_completed_gr`, 'putaway_mode',
		s.`putaway_mode`, 'default_loading_bay', CAST(s.`default_loading_bay` AS CHAR), 'is_loading_bay', s.`is_loading_bay`, 'storage_location_id', CAST(s.`storage_location_id` AS CHAR),
		'category', s.`category`, 'show_hu', s.`show_hu`) AS j FROM putaway_setup s
 WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.organizationId}}' AND s.plant_id = {{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.plantId}}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LB' AS k, sl.id AS sid, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(sl.`id` AS CHAR), 'plant_id', CAST(sl.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', sl.`organization_id`, 'storage_location_code',
		sl.`storage_location_code`, 'location_type', sl.`location_type`, 'is_default', sl.`is_default`, 'storage_status', sl.`storage_status`, 'table_bin_location', sl.`table_bin_location`) AS j FROM storage_location sl
 WHERE sl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND sl.is_deleted = 0 AND sl.storage_status = 1 AND sl.is_default = 1
   AND sl.location_type = 'Loading Bay' AND sl.plant_id = {{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.plantId}}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TO' AS k, r.id AS sid, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(r.id AS CHAR), 'business_type', r.business_type, 'is_default', r.is_default) AS j
  FROM su_code_serial_no_rule r WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.department_id = {{node:code_node_RSkeys.data.organizationId}} AND r.business_type = 'Putaway' AND r.is_default = 1
) x ORDER BY x.k, x.sid

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS job_id, j.job_status, j.correlation_id,
       g.gr_status, g.gr_no, CAST(g.gr_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS gr_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('GRC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  LEFT JOIN goods_receiving g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_RSguard.data.key}}' AND j.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1
